annotation.evidence_span: MUST only occur once per challenge
annotation.interpretation_a: The constraint applies to all authentication parameters across all challenges. A parameter name cannot be reused in *any* challenge.
annotation.interpretation_b: The constraint applies only within a single challenge. A parameter name cannot be reused within the same challenge, but can be reused in different challenges.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'per challenge' is incomplete. It is unclear whether the uniqueness constraint applies to a single challenge instance or to all challenges encountered during a session or communication. This affects how an implementation would handle duplicate parameter names.
annotation.missing_information: The scope of 'challenge' is not defined. Is a 'challenge' a single HTTP request/response exchange, or a broader context (e.g., a session)?
